f55: Melee heroes are masters of close-quarters combat, relying on their weapons to unleash savage attacks. From knights and rogues to lancers, barbarians, and monks, they weave through enemies and strike with unmatched force and precision. Melee fighters excel at delivering raw, powerful blows and can sometimes cleave through multiple foes at once. Always on the front lines, these warriors embody the essence of ferocity and skill, turning the tide of battle with relentless attacks and unwavering resolve.

Magic heroes weave the mystical arts into all manner of destructive and defensive spells. They excel at dealing damage to both single targets and large groups, raining fire, frost, arcane, nature, shadow, or holy damage upon their foes. While most Magic heroes prefer to remain at a distance, many have found ways to channel their spellcraft into powerful defensive spells, using their Mana as a means to defend against harm. Whether acting as a Wizard or an indomitable Mage Knight, Magic heroes are forces of destruction on the battlefield.

Hybrid heroes have mastered the art of martial and magical combat, becoming spellswords. They seamlessly blend their mage-craft into dazzling displays of close-range fighting, infusing elemental might into their weapons, cleaving through foes with frozen blades, or even using shadow magic to enhance their assassination abilities. Some Hybrid augment their fighting capabilities with a single element, while others use powerful manipulative and control spells to become better warriors.

Pure Healers focus entirely on restoring and rejuvenating allies. Able to not only heal and resurrect, but also shield and prevent damage entirely, Pure Healers devote their attention and mana more to their party than to enemies. Using powerful direct heals, buffs, and control spells, they keep their party strong and moving forward.

Combat Healers seamlessly weave back and forth between healing allies and damaging enemies: oftentimes doing both simultaneously. Many Combat Healers heal by siphoning life from foes and giving it to their allies. Others build up power by healing to unleash devastating spells on enemies. While not as potent as their Pure Healer counterparts, Combat Healers make up for it by assisting in dealing damage and slaying enemies faster.
